_comment: Dual GitHub account routing. Read by scripts/github/gh-for.ps1 and
WHY PATH-DETERMINED AND NOT `gh auth switch`:
gh auth switch changes a GLOBAL active account. Its failure mode is silent
-- you push to the company repo as your personal account, or commit company
work with a personal email, and nothing errors. Routing on the directory you
are standing in has no mode to be in and nothing to remember to switch.
ROUTES are matched LONGEST PREFIX FIRST, so a company folder nested inside the
home directory wins over the catch-all. Paths are compared case-insensitively
with forward slashes, because Windows will hand you both spellings.
